Metadata.title: Radiant Central Vietnam
Metadata.description: Discover Hue, Da Nang and Hoi An through destinations, cuisine, community stories and personalized travel itineraries.

common.fallbackNotice: Fresh data could not be loaded. Sample data is being shown.

editorial.description: There is no need to rush. Choose a city, stay long enough, and let the small details lead you into the story of Central Vietnam.

destinations.title: Places that stay with you long after the journey.
destinations.description: From imperial landmarks and beaches to ancient streets, every stop carries its own culture, atmosphere and rhythm of life.

cuisine.title: A region you can remember through its aromas.
cuisine.description: The cuisine here is bold yet unhurried, humble yet layered with flavor. Start with familiar dishes and discover something new in every bite.

journey.title: Travel at just the right pace to leave you wanting to return.
journey.description: These itineraries are designed around meaningful experiences rather than packed schedules, leaving you time to truly enjoy each city.

experience.title: Journeys told through real emotions.
experience.description: Save a meaningful moment, share a little place you have just discovered, or tell the story of a morning you never want to forget.

lantern.title: A night beneath the lantern lights
lantern.imageAlt: Lanterns glowing in Hoi An at night

hueMorning.title: A quiet morning as Hue wakes

beach.title: A day of nothing but sea and wind
beach.imageAlt: A seaside experience in Da Nang

planner.title: Tell us about the journey you have been dreaming of.
planner.description: Choose your number of days, budget and interests. The assistant will combine local data to create an itinerary designed around you.
planner.examplePrompt: I have 4 days, love heritage and local food, and would like to spend one afternoon at the beach.
